question: For each customer and each month of 2020, first calculate the month-end balance by adding all deposit amounts and subtracting all withdrawal amounts that occurred during that specific month. Then determine which month in 2020 has the highest count of customers with a positive month-end balance and which month has the lowest count. For each of these two months, compute the average month-end balance across all customers and provide the difference between these two averages
sql:
WITH monthly_customer_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) - 
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date LIKE '2020%'
    GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', CAST(txn_date AS DATE))
),
month_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 END) as positive_balance_count,
        AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_balance
    FROM monthly_customer_balances
    GROUP BY month
),
extreme_months AS (
    SELECT month, avg_balance, positive_balance_count
    FROM month_summary
    WHERE positive_balance_count = (
        SELECT MAX(positive_balance_count) FROM month_summary
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT month, avg_balance, positive_balance_count
    FROM month_summary
    WHERE positive_balance_count = (
        SELECT MIN(positive_balance_count) FROM month_summary
    )
),
highest_month AS (
    SELECT avg_balance FROM extreme_months WHERE positive_balance_count = (SELECT MAX(positive_balance_count) FROM month_summary)
),
lowest_month AS (
    SELECT avg_balance FROM extreme_months WHERE positive_balance_count = (SELECT MIN(positive_balance_count) FROM month_summary)
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM highest_month) - (SELECT avg_balance FROM lowest_month) as difference
